text.en: The outcome is clearly multifactorial, so searching for a single decisive cause is likely to distort the explanation.

translations.fa: نتیجه کاملاً چندعاملیه، پس دنبال یک علت واحد و تعیین‌کننده گشتن احتمالاً توضیح رو تحریف می‌کنه.

text.en: A correlation becomes more persuasive when we can identify a plausible mechanism connecting the change to the outcome.

translations.fa: همبستگی وقتی قانع‌کننده‌تر می‌شه که بتونیم یک سازوکار منطقی بین تغییر و نتیجه پیدا کنیم.

text.en: Seasonality is a possible confounder because it affects both usage and purchasing behavior during the same period.

text.en: The policy may influence retention indirectly, through a pathway mediated by trust rather than price itself.

translations.fa: سیاست شاید غیرمستقیم روی ماندگاری اثر بذاره، از مسیری که اعتماد واسطه‌شه نه خود قیمت.

text.en: The relevant counterfactual is what would probably have happened without the intervention, not what happened before it.

translations.fa: خلاف‌واقع مرتبط اینه که بدون مداخله احتمالاً چه اتفاقی می‌افتاد، نه صرفاً قبل از مداخله چه اتفاقی افتاده بود.

text.en: The effect appears contingent on local capacity, which explains why the same intervention produced different outcomes across sites.

translations.fa: به نظر می‌رسه اثر به ظرفیت محلی وابسته‌ست و همین توضیح می‌ده چرا یک مداخله در جاهای مختلف نتایج متفاوت داده.

text.en: Even a convincing mechanism does not eliminate alternative causes; it simply makes one explanation more coherent with the evidence.

text.en: A strong causal account combines timing, mechanism, counterfactual reasoning and explicit treatment of plausible confounders.

data.title: Mixed conditionals
data.rule_summary: Combine different time references when a past condition has a present result or a present state explains a past outcome.

examples.en: If we had invested earlier, we would be in a stronger position now.

data.title: Counterfactual past and regret
data.rule_summary: Use would have, could have, might have, and if only to evaluate unreal past alternatives and their consequences.

explanation.fa: برای ارزیابی گزینه‌های فرضی در گذشته و پیامدهایشان از would have، could have، might have و if only استفاده می‌کنیم.

examples.en: We could have avoided the delay if the warning had been taken seriously.

examples.en: If only we had checked the assumptions first.
examples.fa: کاش اول فرض‌ها را بررسی کرده بودیم.

data.title: Advanced hedging and calibration
